title: OCFL 1.1 Object Inventory, as the TAP file store writes it
description: Authored for TAP from the text of the OCFL 1.1 specification, section 3.5 (Inventory), not copied from another project (specs/spec-tap-file-store.md, req-tap-files-ocfl). It describes every inventory the store writes and is checked against every inventory the store reads before it is trusted. It is narrower than OCFL where the store chooses to be: digest algorithm sha256 only, no fixity block, the default content directory, unpadded version numbers, and exactly one logical path per version state (req-tap-files-ocfl).

id.description: The object identifier: urn:uuid: and the canonical lower-case UUID of the file's node (req-tap-files-naming).

type.description: OCFL 3.5.1: the inventory type URI for OCFL 1.1.

digestAlgorithm.description: OCFL 3.5.1 permits sha256; the store uses it everywhere.

head.description: OCFL 3.5.1: the most recent version, vN with no zero padding.

manifest.description: OCFL 3.5.2: each content digest to the content paths, relative to the object root, holding those bytes.

versions.description: OCFL 3.5.3: every version from v1 to the head.

created.description: OCFL 3.5.3.1: the time of the version, RFC 3339 with a zone.

state.description: OCFL 3.5.3.1: digest to logical paths. The store keeps exactly one digest and one logical path per version.

message.description: The operation, and the caller's short reason when one was given.

user.description: OCFL 3.5.3.1: the actor. name is the acting actor's stable key, never an email address.
